# Modules {#sec-modules}

This page lists the addons that carry module functions. Each function file is
`functions/fnc_<name>.sqf`. Functions use the name
`aee_<component>_fnc_<name>`.

## core

The orchestrator. It initialises the mod, registers the EDEN module, updates
the environment, and reports diagnostics.

| Function | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `calculateSeededWeatherProgression` | Compute a deterministic weather quality factor from a seeded LCG |
| `deterministicRandom` | Generate a deterministic pseudo-random value from two integer seeds |
| `diagnostic` | Report diagnostic information |
| `init` | Initialise the mod at mission start |
| `moduleInit` | Initialise the EDEN module |
| `moduleStormInit` | Initialise the storm control EDEN module |
| `updateEnvironment` | Orchestrate the environment update |

### Human-vision perception model

The model derives the normal-vision tone, contrast, white balance and mesopic
tint from published human-vision science. It subsumes the aesthetic base grade
in place and reuses the registry keys `BaseGrade` and `BaseAcuity`. The design
decision is in ADR-014.

| Function | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `perceptionChromaticAdaptation` | Derive the partial von Kries blend toward the display white |
| `perceptionIlluminant` | Normalise the scene illuminant to unit luma |
| `perceptionMesopicColor` | Derive the mesopic desaturation and Purkinje colorize slot |
| `perceptionParams` | Compose the tone and colour stages into the display arrays |
| `perceptionToneResponse` | Derive display brightness, contrast and offset from the adapted luminance |

## ai

The reusable stimulus-response substrate. It runs the four stages sense,
decide, act and recover over a registry of agents, and it holds a decaying
disturbance field that every machine computes deterministically.

| Function | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `agentDecide` | Map the sense state and the thresholds to one action |
| `agentRegister` | Register an agent with the substrate |
| `agentSense` | Read the local stimuli into a state array |
| `agentUnregister` | Remove an agent from the substrate |
| `aiTick` | Run the four-stage model over the registry |
| `disturbanceApply` | Raise a disturbance cell to a stronger stimulus |
| `disturbanceKey` | Map a position to its disturbance cell |
| `disturbanceSample` | Read the decayed disturbance at a cell |
| `initAI` | Start the substrate client tick |
| `receiveStimulus` | Apply a broadcast stimulus to the local field |
| `reportStimulus` | Broadcast one rate-limited stimulus |
| `stimulusDecay` | Decay a stimulus magnitude over its half-life |
| `teardownAI` | Stop the substrate client tick |

## wildlife

The client-local ambient-sound ecology. It reads the biome, the time, the
weather, the water and the disturbance field, and it plays a vanilla sound
bed that reacts to quiet approach, flight spooks and gunfire. It reuses
vanilla media only.

| Function | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `disturbanceSilence` | Map the disturbance to an ambient gain multiplier |
| `initWildlife` | Start the wildlife client tick |
| `playAmbientBed` | Play the ambient bed for one context |
| `playOneShot` | Play a local positional one-shot |
| `soundBedForContext` | Select the ambient context key and the gain |
| `spookRange` | Compute the flight-initiation distance |
| `spookWave` | Raise a ring of disturbance cells around a position |
| `teardownWildlife` | Stop the wildlife client tick |
| `wildlifeTick` | The single wildlife client tick |

## main

The bootstrapper. It loads the mod and its dependencies.

## Compat addons

The compat addons gate on their host mod. Each uses `requiredAddons` and
`skipWhenMissingDependencies`. A compat addon loads only when its host mod is
present.

| Addon | Function | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `compat_ace3` | `integrateKestrel` | Populate ACE3 weather state for the Kestrel |
| `compat_ace3` | `integrateMedical` | Integrate ACE3 medical |
| `compat_acm` | `integrateACM` | Integrate ACM |
| `compat_acm` | `registerHypoxiaDutyFactor` | Register the hypoxia duty factor with ACM |
| `compat_acre2` | `integrateACRE2` | Integrate ACRE2 |
| `compat_kat` | `integrateKAT` | Integrate KAT |
| `compat_realweather` | `integrateRealWeather` | Read weather.json and publish real values |
| `compat_tfar` | `integrateTFAR` | Integrate TFAR |
